title: 4 BR Rosemary Beach Rental with a Private Pool & Gulf Views
meta_description: Bella Cottage, a 4BR, 4.5BA Rosemary Beach home with a private pool, multiple balconies, Gulf views, and close to the beach walkover. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes• Living room Audio/Video with 65" Smart 4K TV, Apple TV, Logitech Elite All-In-One Remote & Sonos Sound System!• High-Speed Wifi Internet Access• Several Balconies & Porches and Slight Gulf View from 3rd Floor Balcony• 1 Minute walk to beach walkover I• 10-second walk to Barbados Pool• Clean Bedding Program• Private Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)Enjoy Gulf views from this gracious family vacation home. Bella Cottage's intelligent architectural design features multiple balconies and window lookouts on all levels. The exterior is painted in green earth tones that blend in with the native flora of Rosemary Beach.Inside, each room is filled with natural light. The decor features a blend of natural fibers, warm woods, and stone. The large, professionally equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances and polished stone countertops for family snacks or evening drinks. Another wonderful family gathering spot is the long dining table under a simple, rustic chandelier.One of the home’s most magical rooms is the children’s bedroom with four built-in twin beds tucked away at the top of the cottage under an arched ceiling. Glass French doors lead out onto a private balcony. Each of the other bedrooms holds a private bath.Need a little more space? Check out the Bella Carriage House, located above the garage in the courtyard. Rents separately.Located steps from the Barbados Pool and a short walk for the white sands of the Rosemary Beach coastline.HOME HIGHLIGHTS:FIRST FLOOR- Primary bedroom with King Bed and separate his and hers full on-suite bathrooms. One with a tub and the other with a shower- Two Queen guest bedrooms with on-suite full bathrooms- Laundry CenterSECOND FLOOR- Large Living Room with ample seating and game table with 4 chairs- Dining area with seating at large dining table for 8- Kitchen with Granite Counters, Stainless Steel Appliances, seating for 4 at counter bar- Half Bath- Access to two large balconies with outdoor dining table plus seating area with couch and chairs- 4 burner grill accessible from kitchen area on small balconyTHIRD FLOOR- Large loft area with 4 twin beds and 2 twin trundle beds- Balcony with amazing views- Sitting area with a full bathroomTDT-040578
